name: tail base v2
note: tail base v2 (2026-10-14), for tailbase_v2_post.py / tailbase_v2_field.py, appended after P-neck3 in place of P-tailbase1. Coordinator ruling 2026-10-14: the crotch may be reshaped behind and under the lowest tail's root; the front view of the hips and groin is held (outline within .001). As tail base v1 (spec tailbase-v1.json) except: hole.d .05 (the old collar's rim lay just outside v1's .035 and printed as ripple bands round the lowest tail's root); hole.add refills the cleft's lower end and the back of the perineum with the rest of the hole, so the biharmonic fill builds them as one smooth saddle; no hole.exclude and no joinProtect (v1 kept the arch and left a crimp); hole.floorFix keeps the air under the front-view arch outline (per x, the lowest solid z in the front window y -.12 to -.035) as it is behind the root up to y .06, and joinFloor takes the body fillet to zero within .012 above that outline, so nothing hangs below it; floor: a soft safety maximum at that outline behind y -.035; keepY [-.055, -.015]: in front of the arch the skin is its own; move.rootOffset lifts the lowest tail's centreline start .035 (fading out by s .15) so its tube clears the arch and its fillet runs all the way round; tailUnionK .045 (the V seam between the middle and lowest tails); finalBlur sigma .01 over the perineum; spotRelax adds the +x buttock under the middle tail and the tops and undersides of the lowest and top tails' roots (ripples where the lifted root bends). World units, +y back.
